title: Final web acceptance and QA verdict
summary: The repo contains a working, validated local web app, `make typecheck` and `make test` now pass on this machine, and repo-side validation assumptions were repaired. Final host-project Xcode acceptance remains blocked by a missing local iOS 26.4 platform install, not by repo code.
blockers: Local Xcode host-project validation cannot find an eligible iOS destination because the machine is missing the iOS 26.4 platform component.
required_followups: Install the local iOS 26.4 platform/component in Xcode and rerun `make ci`.
Rerun `bash ./scripts/run_xcode_coverage.sh` and `bash ./scripts/check_coverage_policy.sh` after the platform is installed.
Run manual browser/device sanity if release sign-off needs device confidence.
